{{Event infobox | location = Lost Basilica | type = group event | indicator = collect | level = 80 | meta event = The Basilica Vaults | previous = Defeat the ancient defenses and gather their power for Isgarren | success = Defeat the champion enchanted weapon | coordinates = [6774.9, 57812.1] | requires = voe }} [[Gather the loose magic for Isgarren]] is the second event of [[The Basilica Vaults]] [[meta event]]. It takes place deep in [[Lost Basilica]], which is inaccessible outside of the meta event. == Objectives == * Coalesced Magic
{{event bar empty}} [[File:Coalesced Magic icon.png|20 px]] * Your contribution: x * Time to turn in objective: 0:xx (when event bar is full) == Rewards == {{Event rewards}} * One Event Bouncy Chest: ** {{rewards item|Antiquated Ducats|qty=25}} ** {{rewards item|Piece of Unidentified Gear|qty=1-2|chance=chance}} ** {{rewards item|Piece of Rare Unidentified Gear|qty=1|chance=chance}} ** Chance of an {{rarity|Exotic}} rarity piece of equipment *{{Rewards item|Starlit Weald Renown Token|qty=1}} == Walkthrough == * Upon entering the room, the player gains {{effect|Mounts Disabled}} effect and {{effect|Cosmic Energy}} effect. * Be wary of aerial traps as well as floor traps (dark purple circles on the floor). The floor traps can also be on the elevated platform and cover them entirely. * Navigate the room to gather [[Coalesced Magic]] for [[Isgarren]]. Make good use of the {{effect|Cosmic Energy}} effect and of the [[Ley lines]] in the middle of the room if you have [[Ley Line Gliding]] [[mastery]]. * Isgarren is vulnerable during this event and hp will decrease. Handing in Coalesced Magic heals him. Player skills will not heal him. If he is downed, he can be resurrected. === Skills === {| {{STDT|pve}} {{Environmental skill table header}} {{Environmental skill table row|Rush (rabbit icon)}} |} == NPCs == === Allies === * [[Isgarren]] === Foes === {{section-stub}} * [[Arcane Seeker]] * [[Arcane Spreadshot]] == Objects == * {{event icon|gather}} [[Coalesced Magic]] == Dialogue == ;Event start :'''Isgarren:''' ''This system has degraded with time. Nevertheless, you'll need to acquire its power source to continue.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''I would do so myself, but I suspect my presence would only exacerbate the situation.'' :''':''' ''That's becoming something of a trend.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Those with a strong distaste for me have a long and rich tradition, [[Wayfinder]].'' ;Event success :'''Isgarren:''' ''Ah, very good. Let us proceed.'' :''':''' ''What exactly do you expect to find here?'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Secrets that are best kept that way.'' :''':''' ''That's an unsatisfying answer. What do you know that I don't?'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Wayfinder, I have lived for millennia. What I know that you do not could fill libraries. It does, in fact.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''You are capable of understanding, but we simply lack the centuries necessary to catch you.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Shall we continue?''
title: Gather the loose magic for Isgarren
